project.title: Shotgun proteomic analysis of the secretomes from white-rot fungus Coriolopsis gallica in presence or absence of levofloxacin.
project.projectDescription: Proteomic and proteogenomics analyses of secretomes from  the white-rot fungus Coriolopsis gallica in presence or absence of levofloxacin in order to identify the proteins involved in the degradataion of the fluoroquinolone.
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: Protein samples were loaded on a SDS-PAGE for a short migration, excised from a single polyacrylamide band, treated with chemical reagents for fixing the cysteine modification, digested with trypsin, and the resulting peptides were analyzed by Q-Exactive HF tandem mass spectrometry.
project.dataProcessingProtocol: MS/MS spectra were analyzed by MASCOT against a database of nucleic acid sequence contigs (proteogenomics) or a Coriolopsis gallica protein sequence partial database (proteomics), the results were then parsed, spectral counts were extracted and compared.
